allocation.note: the variant-test amount is what remains if every earlier phase spends its full cap; money the baseline does not spend is added only by a new owner approval. At the pre-registered K = 2 per arm one variant test costs about its expected figure and the budget supports ONE; a second needs a new decision

cost_basis: calculated at published prices; assumptions in exp2/costs.py; not a bill
